# AI Verdict

> AI Verdict is a Russian platform built on two foundational practices: legal and engineering. Their key intersection is legal function automation; each practice also handles work within its own professional scope.

## Practices and their intersection

- Key intersection — legal function automation: https://ai-verdict.ru/services
  Contracts, legal intake, litigation workflows, compliance, knowledge bases, deadlines, approvals, legal analytics, and integrations with company systems.
- Legal practice — legal services under Russian law: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help
  Online legal consultations, contracts, disputes, corporate matters, real estate, family, inheritance, debt collection, employment, and regional legal assistance.
- Engineering practice — software development and integrations: https://ai-verdict.ru/engineering
  Telegram bots, websites, Mini Apps, internal software, AI modules, dashboards, and integrations with CRM, ERP, 1C, EDI, databases, and APIs.

## Authority and Scope

- Canonical website: https://ai-verdict.ru/
- Primary language: Russian (`ru-RU`).
- Service area: Russia; regional pages describe remote assistance and do not claim local offices.
- Legal materials are informational until a lawyer reviews a client's facts and documents.
- AI may structure information and prepare drafts, but legal conclusions and client decisions are confirmed by a human specialist.
- Legal and engineering are the two foundational practices; legal automation is their shared specialization, not a third practice.
- Independent legal and engineering projects remain within their respective professional practices and are not presented as one universal service.
